notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Sorry that things have been a little quiet. In the new year, January hit me like a train and then kind of ran me over a few times for good measure. But now things are back on schedule, and the next update is nearly here. All the writing is done, and we just need to have some of the final code mechanics fixed up, so I expect that the next update will come out in the middle of next week or early on the week starting on Feb 17.

As to the content, I've posted a bit of a preview teaser right here in this post. Vynore has a special outfit that she wants to share with you. This is but one part of Vynore's mega scene, the penultimate encounter with our sexy Yokaru troublemaker.

I hope everyone will find something in this scene to enjoy. It even has unique pregnancy content and another fetish that I will announce when the update is ready.

Once the mega scene is out, the only thing left for Vynore is her ending content, her own special vacation with the main character. All of the art for that scene is already complete, so I am hopeful that we will have a second update in late February that helps wrap up everything with Vynore.

After that, my focus will return to Corsoni, some special Kuhno content, and a few other odds and ends to finish up all the content for Sunwave Hotel. Of course once that is done, we'll be looking to grind down any edges and remove any bugs, but it will still feel good having all the content plugged into the game so it can be enjoyed by the fans.

And I think that is it for now. Thanks for stopping by, and have a great rest of your weekend.
